description: Make QR codes and read them back, with QR Server (goQR.me). Put a link or any text into a code, or build the ones people actually need: a Wi-Fi code that joins the network when a guest scans it, a contact code a phone saves to its address book, an event code it adds to a calendar. Choose the size, colours and file type, and get a PNG for the web or a vector file for print. Reading works the other way: hand it an image or a photo of a code and get the text back. No account or API key required.
